title: Hybrid KV aging-bucket allocator with decode-priority quotas and opportunistic prefill merging
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: Our paged KV cache suffers from frequent micro-fragmentation when requests with heterogeneous sequence lengths populate and evict slots. This increases memory pressure and forces expensive compaction. At high QPS the prefill pipeline competes with decode for GPU work, causing head-of-line latency spikes for latency-sensitive requests.

Proposal: Implement a hybrid segmented allocator that groups KV pages into aging buckets (fast-turnover, mid-lived, long-lived). Each bucket uses a different allocation strategy: fast-turnover uses small fixed-size pages with aggressive LRU replacement, mid-lived uses coalescing-friendly slab pages, and long-lived allows pinned segments for long-context sessions. Introduce decode-priority quotas and a small real-time prefill throttle so that prefill tasks are preemptible and bounded by a per-model decode-priority budget. Add an opportunistic prefill merging pass that combines adjacent KV fragments during low-util windows to reduce fragmentation without blocking hot decode paths.

Goals: reduce active memory overhead by 20% for mixed-length workloads, limit tail latency degradation from prefill to <5% p99 overhead, and cut background compaction cycles by 30% on average.
acceptance_criteria: New allocator deployed behind runtime-flag with no regression in correctness for streaming/chat workloads
End-to-end benchmark: mixed-length llama-2-13b workload shows >=20% reduction in allocated KV memory vs baseline
Tail latency: p99 decode latency increase due to prefill <= 5% under steady-state QPS
Background compaction cycles per hour reduced by >=30% on average during traffic replay
Profiling traces show prefill tasks are preemptible and respect per-model decode-priority quotas
implementation_steps: Design: finalize bucket thresholds and page sizes; document in Confluence (link above).
Allocator: implement bucket metadata, allocation/free paths, and per-bucket eviction heuristics.
Prefill pipeline: add per-request decode-priority tag, implement budget accounting and preemptible work units.
Merge pass: implement opportunistic merge task that runs when GPU/CPU utilization < threshold.
Kernel signals: surface lightweight hints from allocator to kernel-selection so kernels prefer contiguous segments when available.
Testing: unit tests for allocator, fault-injection for preemptible prefill, integration tests with streaming API.
Benchmarking: synthetic mixed-length replay + customer traffic replay for regression and memory/latency metrics.
Rollout: runtime-flag rollout -> canary on staging dedicated -> 10% production -> 50% -> 100% with rollback guardrails.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Overly aggressive merging may increase CPU overhead and hurt decode latency. Mitigation: merge only during low utilization windows and bound merge window time.

Risk: Per-model quotas could starve background prefill for low-priority models, increasing cold-starts. Mitigation: allow periodic quota refill and emergency prefill tokens for low-priority models under low load.
Risk: Incorrect bucket thresholds could thrash objects between buckets. Mitigation: ship with telemetry-driven auto-tuning and conservative defaults; include metric 'bucket-migrations/sec'.
updates: 2026-02-18: Ticket created by Sofia. Initial design brainstorm — aging buckets + preemptible prefill recommended.
2026-02-25: Design review with R&D and infra. Decided on three buckets and to surface allocator hints to kernel selector.
2026-03-03: Prototype allocator implemented (allocator branch). Microbenchmarks show 12% memory saving on uniform-length workloads.
2026-03-08: Prefill preemption API landed; added decode-priority tagging to request headers. Integration tests in progress.
2026-03-12: First canary run on staging dedicated cluster. Observed fragmentation ratio drop ~28% but slight p99 decode increase (3.2%). Tuned merge throttle and reduced p99 to 2.1%.
comments: Aaron Chen (assignee): I'll open PRs for allocator and prefill changes separately to keep reviews small. Estimating 2 additional sprints for stabilization.
Elena Gupta (runtime): Need to ensure kernel-selection can consume allocator hints without full ABI changes — propose a single uint32 hint field in request descriptor.
PM note (Ravi Singh): Prioritize no-user-visible regressions. If p99 impact >5% we must pause rollout and revert to previous policy.
Design feedback (Maya Ortiz): Add a small pinned segment pool for long-lived chat sessions to avoid repeated migrations for few users with long contexts.
QA (Tom Baker): Will add traffic replay scenarios including multi-tenant mixed-length sessions and a 24-hour soak test on staging.
Infra (Jae Park): Ensure metrics exports include 'bucket_migrations_per_minute' and a tag for model_id to diagnose hotspots.
Security (Kira Novak): Confirmed no sensitive data is stored in merged fragments; merge runs must respect encryption-at-rest—recommend a short checklist in PR template.
